profile.name: Anfaz Edakkavil Aboobakar
profile.tagline: I build enterprise software and intelligent systems using Java, Python, SQL, and modern AI technologies.
profile.bio: Software Engineer with nearly four years of experience developing and supporting enterprise insurance solutions using XQuery, Java, SQL, and RESTful APIs. Experienced in document-generation systems, query optimisation, production deployments, Agile delivery, and cross-functional collaboration. MSc graduate in Artificial Intelligence with hands-on experience in machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, big data processing, transformer models, multimodal AI, and explainable AI. Based in Cork, Ireland, and open to relocation.

experience.summary: Developed and supported enterprise insurance document-generation solutions for the Aetna platform on Majesco Cloud Insurer, earning three promotions during the tenure.
highlights: Rewrote XQuery transformation logic, with supporting Java and SQL development, across 30+ live insurance document templates for Aetna's platform on Majesco Cloud Insurer, cutting document generation time from 5 minutes to 1 minute and reducing recurring formatting defects by 80%.

Validated and troubleshot 25+ monthly production releases using SVN checkout and Majesco DaaS deployment tooling, resolving billing discrepancies by pulling records via Microsoft SQL Server and pushing business-approved corrections through a REST API, and confirming each release's changes reached Aetna's live platform as intended.

Partnered with business analysts, QA engineers, frontend developers, and integration teams on a 20-person Agile team, serving as one of two dedicated engineers on the insurance document-generation (DaaS) platform.
Delivered feature and enhancement work across agent onboarding, group setup and enrolment, and claims-upgrade merges, translating shifting regulatory and business requirements into production code.
Mentored 3 junior engineers on XQuery development and DaaS system architecture, onboarding them to the codebase and reviewing their work, cutting their ramp-up time from roughly 4 weeks to 2 weeks.

projects.title: Multimodal Depression and Positive Affect Detection
projects.subtitle: Explainable multimodal AI for depression detection
projects.description: An end-to-end multimodal AI system combining XLM-RoBERTa text embeddings, audio-visual features, and MentalRoBERTa positive-affect representations. The system integrates independently trained encoders through projection layers and a neural fusion classifier, achieving an AUROC of 0.9867 and an F1-score of 0.9508.

projects.title: Stock Market Analysis and Price Prediction
projects.subtitle: Django application for market analysis and forecasting
projects.description: A Django web application that collects stock-market information from online sources, presents historical trends through interactive visualisations, and integrates a machine-learning pipeline to generate stock-price predictions from historical data.

projects.title: Parking Management System
projects.subtitle: Full-stack parking management
projects.description: A parking management system built as a full-stack Spring Boot web application. Features session-based authentication, transactional check-in/check-out with row-level slot locking, and a type-to-filter search UI, self-hosted on an Oracle Cloud VM with nginx and TLS.
